activity_summary: At two the plot was Richard the Third at the Theatre. No name of a part was on it for you. You played, and you brought no name home. Across the water the Rose had Crack Me. You did not cross.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played the afternoon, and brought no part-name away.

entities.name: Richard the Third
entities.context: Mentioned in The crookback, no name of a side
